<h2>Description</h2>
'''E-30''', Formally '''M-30''', will be the 2nd entity you will encounter in [[Section E]]. More informationabout this entity is shown below.

<h2>Mechanics</h2>
Once Spawned, '''E-30''' will appear behind the void wall and begin rushing to the main room at a moderate without warning, once it hits the door, it will Despawn.

<h2>Strategies</h2>
Since '''E-30''' doesn't give any warning to hint that it spawned, you will need to keep your ears open and hide immediately after you hear him.

<h2>Trivia</h2>
* '''E-30''' was originally named M-30, before being replaced by [[M-22]] and moved to [[Section E]]
* '''E-30''' used OG RFF [https://rooms-found-footage.fandom.com/wiki/I-30 I-30's] old design as a Placeholder during development.
* '''E-30''' can't break the door if it needs a keycard to be opened and he'll just go through without breaking it.
<h2>Lore</h2>
* '''E-30''' is M-30 but in a drone type state due to an escape attempt that would kill M-30. This would in turn make him a drone.
* '''E-30''' possibly got in the [[Section E]] during his successful escape attempt after he was killed and made into this sector.

<h2>Description</h2>
'''I-30''' is the 1st Entity present within the final 100 rooms of [[Section UI]], more info on '''I-30''' shown below.

<h2>Mechanics</h2>
Once Spawned, it will appear behind the void wall and begin rushing to the main room at a moderate without warning, once it hits the door, it will Despawn.

<h2>Strategies</h2>
* Since '''I-30''' doesn't give any warning to hint that it spawned, you will need to keep your ears open and hide immediately after you hear him.
* if [[M-60#Section_UI|I-60]] is active,  you should either stay hiden for the entire encounter, or if in a previous room, exit your locker and look back at the previous rooms, since [[M-60#Section_UI|I-60]] will completely block the sounds coming from '''I-30'''
